Review changes requested: FU10 elapsed-time math is correct (01:14:37Z -> 04:18:14Z = ~3h03m; 4h threshold at 05:14:37Z leaves ~56m23s), but the imminent-threshold claim is internally inconsistent. The packet says current cadence is ~12-23 minutes per packet; with ~56 minutes remaining, FOLLOWUP-11 and possibly later packets could still arrive before 05:14:37Z, so 'last likely pre-threshold packet' and 'Any FOLLOWUP-11 or later packet will likely arrive after the threshold' must be revised. Keep the loop-halt recommendation and single-action brief, but change the alert framing to threshold-approaching instead of last-likely-pre-threshold. No canonical truth changes requested.

Alert framing corrected per review feedback. Threshold-approaching framing replaces imminent/last-packet claims. Escalation math, loop-halt recommendation, and single-action brief unchanged. Ready for re-review at commit 6da35c0f.
